title: Pecan embryo total-RNA extraction: evidence-constrained protocol audit

problem.question: Extract high-quality total RNA from pecan (Carya illinoinensis) embryos for small RNA and transcriptome sequencing. Pecan embryos are oil-rich and polyphenol-rich, and the tissue is recalcitrant to standard extraction.
problem.source_text: Extract high-quality total RNA from pecan (Carya illinoinensis) embryos for small RNA and transcriptome sequencing. Pecan embryos are oil-rich and polyphenol-rich, and the tissue is recalcitrant to standard extraction.

steps.label: Collect and preserve pecan embryos
steps.action: Remove the pericarp and seed coat, freeze the embryos in liquid nitrogen, and store them at −80 °C until extraction.

parameters.name: storage_temperature
parameters.basis: stated in the pecan methods

parameters.name: storage_duration
parameters.basis: the pecan methods do not state how long the embryos were stored before extraction

unknowns: time between harvest and freezing
steps.notes: The stage series is DAF120 to DAF180, but the RNA protocol itself does not state how long the embryos were stored.

steps.label: Extract total RNA with a TRIzol kit
steps.action: Extract total RNA from pecan embryos with the Invitrogen TRIzol kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

parameters.name: trizol_volume
parameters.basis: the pecan methods defer to the manufacturer's protocol and print no volume

parameters.name: homogenisation_time
parameters.basis: the pecan methods print no homogenisation time

parameters.name: phase_separation_speed
parameters.basis: the pecan methods print no centrifugation speed

parameters.name: precipitation_temperature
parameters.basis: the pecan methods print no precipitation temperature

parameters.name: elution_volume
parameters.basis: the pecan methods print no elution volume

unknowns: whether the manufacturer's protocol was followed without modification
steps.notes: The pecan paper names the kit and defers the parameters to the manufacturer; none of those parameters is printed in the paper.

steps.label: Remove genomic DNA with RNase-free DNase I
steps.action: Treat the extracted RNA with RNase-free DNase I to remove genomic DNA.

parameters.name: dnase_amount
parameters.basis: the pecan methods name the enzyme but not the amount

parameters.name: dnase_temperature
parameters.basis: the pecan methods print no digestion temperature

parameters.name: dnase_time
parameters.basis: the pecan methods print no digestion time

parameters.name: inactivation_temperature
parameters.basis: the pecan methods print no inactivation temperature

unknowns: DNase inactivation duration
steps.notes: Only the enzyme supplier is named; the digestion parameters are not reported.

steps.label: Assess RNA quality and concentration
steps.action: Check RNA integrity by agarose gel electrophoresis and measure concentration and absorbance ratios on a NanoDrop 2000.

parameters.name: rna_yield
parameters.basis: the pecan text names the assay but reports no yield value

parameters.name: a260_a280
parameters.basis: the pecan text reports no A260/A280 value

parameters.name: a260_a230
parameters.basis: the pecan text reports no A260/A230 value

parameters.name: rin
parameters.basis: the pecan text reports no RIN value

unknowns: which samples were measured and whether any measurement failed
steps.notes: The assay is named, but no pecan measurement is reported in the paper text; the values remain unknown.

steps.label: Enrich 18–30 nt small RNA by PAGE
steps.action: Enrich small RNA in the 18–30 nucleotide size range by polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis before library construction.

parameters.name: size_min
parameters.basis: stated in the pecan methods

parameters.name: size_max
parameters.basis: stated in the pecan methods

parameters.name: page_gel_percentage
parameters.basis: the pecan methods print no gel percentage

parameters.name: rna_loaded

unknowns: elution or recovery method after gel excision

steps.label: Reverse transcribe 1 μg RNA to cDNA
steps.action: Use 1 μg of total RNA per sample for reverse transcription and cDNA library construction.

steps.label: Wash, dry and elute RNA — Norway spruce (analogue)

steps.action: Record that TRIzol gave compromised purity and integrity for Norway spruce, so a TRIzol kit name alone does not establish pecan performance.

assumptions: A protocol reported for a different species is a hypothesis, not a measurement on the requested organism.
A parameter absent from the acquired text stays unknown; it is never imputed, defaulted or placed at zero.
The model audits evidence coverage and protocol readiness. It does not predict RNA yield, integrity or degradation.
Only quotes that were found verbatim in an acquired source are allowed to support a step.

readiness.statement: This audits what the literature establishes. A complete protocol for the target organism, a quantitative yield, and an analogue protocol are three different findings; this block keeps them apart.
